why: Never reports an overlap. The cheapest way to give a small control a 44 px target is to grow its box, and growing boxes in a wrapping row or a negative-margin cluster is exactly how two targets come to cover the same pixels. Issue #686 requires that no enlarged target creates ambiguous pointer or touch ownership; without this check, a size fix that did that would pass.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) fails two controls whose boxes overlap, and not two that only share an edge
